posts.text:
On the 250th birthday of the United States, our President called to pass the SAVE America Act to require proof of citizenship to vote in our elections. This is something over 80% of Americans want. 

The House has now passed it THREE TIMES and each time we pass it to the Senate they FAIL.

The people want it. The House wants it. The President wants it.

@leaderthune is claiming it’s a numbers problem. I think it’s evident it’s a leadership problem.
